gloss: cancellation of a contract; breach of contract

definitions.gloss: cancellation of a contract; contract termination; breach of contract
definitions.explanation: The act of canceling, voiding, or breaking a contract. Can refer to either a lawful termination or an unlawful breach.

examples.japanese: {契約破棄|けいやくはき}を{申|もう}し{出|で}た。
examples.english: I requested cancellation of the contract.

examples.japanese: {一方的|いっぽうてき}な{契約破棄|けいやくはき}は{損害賠償|そんがいばいしょう}の{対象|たいしょう}になる。
examples.english: Unilateral contract cancellation may be subject to damages.

examples.japanese: {相手方|あいてがた}の{契約違反|けいやくいはん}を{理由|りゆう}に{契約破棄|けいやくはき}を{通告|つうこく}した。
examples.english: I notified the other party of the contract cancellation due to their breach.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {契約|けいやく} (contract) and {破棄|はき} (annulment, cancellation). Used in legal and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {契約破棄|けいやくはき}を{通告|つうこく}する (to notify of contract cancellation)
- {一方的|いっぽうてき}な{契約破棄|けいやくはき} (unilateral contract cancellation)
- {契約破棄|けいやくはき}の{理由|りゆう} (reason for contract cancellation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {契約解除|けいやくかいじょ}: contract termination — more formal legal term for lawful cancellation
- {契約違反|けいやくいはん}: breach of contract — the act of violating contract terms
